entities.name: RlmN-like protein
observations: The 366-aa query has 68.0% identity and 99.2% query coverage to reviewed Opitutus terrae RlmN3 (UniProt B2A0B9); Pfam detects RlmN_N and Radical_SAM domains.
Reviewed homolog annotations assign methylation of 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37; exact dual substrate specificity is inferred for this query by homology.
Close reviewed homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic; localization of this query is homology-based.

entities.name: rRNA methylation
observations: RlmN homolog annotations support rRNA adenine base methylation, specifically 23S rRNA A2503 C2 methylation.

entities.name: tRNA methylation
observations: RlmN homolog annotations support tRNA adenine base methylation, specifically tRNA A37 C2 methylation.

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: Close reviewed RlmN homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic; this is a homology-based localization assignment for the query.
